Provenance for 78 independently authored Japanese keyword-grid records in:
  web/card-keyword-grid.js (five initial prototypes)
  web/card-keyword-corpus.js (73 supplementary records)
Tarotoo Tarot Card Meanings Dataset
https://github.com/Tarotoo-com/tarotoo-tarot-dataset
data/cards.json verified at commit 83202267973950eb5bf034f144b9405db9cb1e7e
MIT License; Copyright (c) 2026 Tarotoo (tarotoo.com).

These 78 records are newly composed Japanese headings/terms informed by Tarotoo's
licensed English descriptions (upright, reversed, love, career, mood, spiritual).
They are independent editorial summaries; no original English dataset text is
reproduced verbatim, and no runtime Tarotoo API is called.
The user's likely-transcribed third-party original, its 5x4 terms and distinct
selection/arrangement, and any third-party diagram images are NOT incorporated.
See docs/KEYWORD_EDITORIAL_GUIDE.md and docs/KEYWORD_W2_PROVENANCE.md.
Neither this notice nor the MIT permission grants rights in third-party content
that Tarotoo may not own. The dataset's own origin/attribution was reviewed for
the limited independently-composed interpretive text used here.
